review.decision: 32/32 case outcomes and 104/104 criteria matched; use Luna without escalation. Not a held-out or all-language accuracy estimate.

generation.method: Production prompts/schema/90s timeout/0 retries; two workers per model, models overlap. Same topics/titles across models. Codex source inspection against predeclared five-part rubric, not blinded or independently human-adjudicated; no numeric semantic accuracy score.

findings.finding: Core solution algorithms for ordinary topics were broadly comparable by source inspection. This does not establish equivalence or exclude unnoticed defects.
Payload-split examples omit a length byte: 00 00 04 61 or 00 00 04 74 denotes 1121/1140, not 4. Generated solution raises ValueError. Focused executable counterexamples confirmed.
Example output ends with ]},{ and note contains an English drafting/schema correction memo despite Korean prose instruction.
Refactoring starter mutates input, rejects only the first error, or computes bool("false") incorrectly. Task requires behavior fixes rather than behavior-preserving refactoring.

Common spec/parser loop preserves ordinary starter behavior and is a clearer refactoring exercise. Starter has a long-int edge defect; solution catches that ValueError per field. Python 3.12 type aliases inspected, not executed on local Python 3.11.

generation.decision: Keep Sol generation for now: lower-cost candidates are promising on ordinary problems but equivalence across required domains/kinds is unproven. This sample does not prove Sol universally superior; Sol also failed. No automatic fallback/routing introduced.

limits: Development cases were reused for review; two runs are a small sample.
Generation scoring is source inspection by the implementing Codex agent, not an independent human benchmark or executable oracle for every language.
Dollar values are token-price estimates at 2026-09-14 rates; exclude unmetered failed request and actual account billing adjustments.
No production DB writes; generated artifacts are evaluation-only and not seeded into the service.
